Load libraries

Load data DESeq2 and EdgeR

# Cargar tablas completas generadas en el script 7 (usando gene_id como rownames)
results_DESeq2 <- read.delim("outputs_Rstudio_dia3//DGE/DESeq2_TCvsDC_170ppb_ALL.txt", row.names = 1)
results_Edge   <- read.delim("outputs_Rstudio_dia3//DGE/EdgeR_TCvsDC_170ppb_ALL.txt", row.names = 1)

# Seleccionar columnas por NOMBRE (mucho más seguro que por índice numérico)
results_DESeq2_rt <- results_DESeq2[, c("log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj")]
results_Edge_rt   <- results_Edge[, c("logFC", "PValue", "FDR")]

# Invertir signo para que el contraste sea DAMAGED vs TOLERANT (logFC > 0 = sobreexpresado en Dañados)
results_DESeq2_rt$log2FoldChange <- results_DESeq2_rt$log2FoldChange * (-1)
results_Edge_rt$logFC            <- results_Edge_rt$logFC * (-1)

# Calcular -log10(p-value) y -log10(FDR)
results_DESeq2_rt$sig    <- -log10(results_DESeq2_rt$pvalue)
results_DESeq2_rt$sigadj <- -log10(results_DESeq2_rt$padj)

results_Edge_rt$sig      <- -log10(results_Edge_rt$PValue)
results_Edge_rt$sigadj   <- -log10(results_Edge_rt$FDR)

# Clasificar DEGs reales (FDR < 0.05 y |log2FC| > 1), manejando NAs de DESeq2 como FALSE
results_DESeq2_rt$TDE <- !is.na(results_DESeq2_rt$padj) & 
                         (results_DESeq2_rt$padj < 0.05) & (abs(results_DESeq2_rt$log2FoldChange) > 1)

results_Edge_rt$TDE   <- !is.na(results_Edge_rt$FDR) & 
                         (results_Edge_rt$FDR < 0.05) & (abs(results_Edge_rt$logFC) > 1)

Common genes (Damaged vs Tolerant)

# Filtrar sobreexpresados (logFC > 1) y subexpresados (logFC < -1) en DAÑADOS
overxpress_Ds2 <- subset(results_DESeq2_rt, TDE & log2FoldChange > 1)
downxpress_Ds2 <- subset(results_DESeq2_rt, TDE & log2FoldChange < -1)

overxpress_Ed  <- subset(results_Edge_rt, TDE & logFC > 1)
downxpress_Ed  <- subset(results_Edge_rt, TDE & logFC < -1)

# Consenso entre ambos métodos
genesDEcomun_over <- intersect(rownames(overxpress_Ds2), rownames(overxpress_Ed))
genesDEcomun_down <- intersect(rownames(downxpress_Ds2), rownames(downxpress_Ed))
comun_genes_od    <- c(genesDEcomun_over, genesDEcomun_down)

cat("Consenso sobreexpresados en Dañados (DC):", length(genesDEcomun_over), "\n")
## Consenso sobreexpresados en Dañados (DC): 17
cat("Consenso subexpresados en Dañados (DC):", length(genesDEcomun_down), "\n")
## Consenso subexpresados en Dañados (DC): 21

Merge tables & assign categories

results_DESeq2_rt$gene_id <- rownames(results_DESeq2_rt)
results_Edge_rt$gene_id   <- rownames(results_Edge_rt)

df_general <- merge(results_DESeq2_rt, results_Edge_rt, by = "gene_id", all = TRUE)

colnames(df_general) <- c(
  "gene_id",
  "log2FoldChange_D2", "pvalue_D2", "padj_D2", "sig_D2", "sigadj_D2", "TDE_D2",
  "logFC_ER", "PValue_ER", "FDR_ER", "sig_ER", "sigadj_ER", "TDE_ER"
)

# Asegurar que ningún NA rompa la clasificación de color
df_general$TDE_D2[is.na(df_general$TDE_D2)] <- FALSE
df_general$TDE_ER[is.na(df_general$TDE_ER)] <- FALSE

df_general$Category <- ifelse(
  df_general$TDE_D2 & df_general$TDE_ER, "Both (DESeq2 & edgeR)",
  ifelse(df_general$TDE_D2 & !df_general$TDE_ER, "Only DESeq2",
    ifelse(!df_general$TDE_D2 & df_general$TDE_ER, "Only edgeR", "Not Significant")
  )
)

# Ordenar factor para controlar el orden de la leyenda y superposición de puntos
df_general$Category <- factor(
  df_general$Category,
  levels = c("Both (DESeq2 & edgeR)", "Only DESeq2", "Only edgeR", "Not Significant")
)

table(df_general$Category)
## 
## Both (DESeq2 & edgeR)           Only DESeq2            Only edgeR 
##                    38                    42                     5 
##       Not Significant 
##                 29767

Export data

# Crear carpetas de salida automáticamente
dir.create("outputs_Rstudio_dia3//Over_Down/SPECIFIC/IDs", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Tabla general completa
write.table(df_general, "outputs_Rstudio_dia3/Over_Down/GENERAL_C_DvsT.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# Subconjuntos por categoría
D2_ER_genes <- subset(df_general, Category == "Both (DESeq2 & edgeR)")
D2_genes    <- subset(df_general, Category == "Only DESeq2")
ER_genes    <- subset(df_general, Category == "Only edgeR")

write.table(D2_ER_genes, "outputs_Rstudio_dia3/Over_Down/SPECIFIC/D2_ER_C_DvsT.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
write.table(D2_genes,    "outputs_Rstudio_dia3/Over_Down/SPECIFIC/D2_C_DvsT.txt",    sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
write.table(ER_genes,    "outputs_Rstudio_dia3/Over_Down/SPECIFIC/ER_C_DvsT.txt",    sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# Listas planas de IDs consenso (sobreexpresados y subexpresados en Dañados)
write.table(genesDEcomun_over, "outputs_Rstudio_dia3/Over_Down/SPECIFIC/IDs/IDs_D2_ER_C_DvsT_overinDamaged.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
write.table(genesDEcomun_down, "outputs_Rstudio_dia3/Over_Down/SPECIFIC/IDs/IDs_D2_ER_C_DvsT_downinDamaged.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
